pages.description: Koinonia Experience is the annual family conference of Christ Connect Family Church, held in Lusaka, Zambia every December. Editions Koi 24', Koi 25' and the upcoming Koi 26'.
pages.text: KOINONIA Experience Once a year the whole Christ Connect family comes home to Lusaka: three days of worship, the Word and fellowship that sends us back out multiplying. I am coming to Koi 26' Watch Koi 25' Next Koi 26', December 2026 Where Lusaka, Zambia Last theme "Going Deep and Multiplying" Every Koinonia Experience Past Koi 24' 21 to 22 December 2024 Two days in Ibex Hill where the family first gathered under the Koinonia name: worship, the Word, and members sharing preaching, songs, dance, poems and testimonies. Open K24 Past Koi 25' "Going Deep and Multiplying" 19 to 21 December 2025 . Grace Exploits Event Center Open K25 Coming soon December 2026 Next Koi 26' December 2026 The next gathering of the family. Dates, venue and theme will be announced here first. Tell us you are coming and we will keep you posted. Open K26 3 days together every December 3+ nations in the room: Zambia, Zimbabwe, Malawi 5 leaders taught at Koi 25' 1 family under Christ What Koinonia means Koinonia is the New Testament word for fellowship: sharing life, not just a room. "They devoted themselves to the apostles' teaching and to fellowship." Acts 2:42. The conference exists so that churches spread across borders remember they are one body, go deep in the Word together, and go home to multiply. From Koi 25' Praise and Worship Medley: Chawama, Hallelujah Hosanna Worship Connect, K25 Praise Medley: You Are So Good, Bena Ba Suma Kuli Ine Worship Connect, K25 Come home this December. Koinonia is where the family remembers it is one body. Whether you belong to a CCFC church or you are curious, there is a seat for you at Koi 26'. I am coming to Koi 26' Visit CCFC Zambia

pages.description: Koinonia 26 Experience: December 2026, Lusaka, Zambia. The next gathering of the family. Dates, venue and theme will be announced here first. Tell us you are coming and we will keep you posted.
pages.text: Next edition KOINONIA 26' Experience The next gathering of the family. Dates, venue and theme will be announced here first. Tell us you are coming and we will keep you posted. I am coming Details When December 2026 Where Lusaka, Zambia The details When December 2026 Where Lusaka, Zambia Who Members, friends and first-time guests from every CCFC church Zambia, Zimbabwe, Malawi and the wider family Watch Videos on the way Recordings from this edition will be added here as the media team uploads them. Moments Photographs from this edition are being added. Registration open Register for Koi 26'. The same questions as the church's conference form, so your place is counted straight away. It takes about two minutes. Dates December 2026 Venue Lusaka, Zambia Delegate fee Announced with the dates. Koi 25' was K200 for Zambian delegates and USD 10 for international delegates. Questions WhatsApp the office or email ccfczambia@gmail.com Questions Before you register. The things people ask the office most about Koinonia. Who can come to Koinonia? Everyone is welcome: members, friends and first-time guests from every CCFC church in Zambia, Zimbabwe, Malawi and the wider family. When and where is Koi 26'? Koi 26' is in December 2026 in Lusaka. The exact dates, venue and theme will be announced on this page first. How much does it cost? The delegate fee is announced with the dates. For Koi 25' it was K200 for Zambian delegates and USD 10 for international delegates. Can I register my children? Yes. Koinonia is a family conference. Fill in the form for each child and choose their age range. Can I take part by preaching, singing or performing? Yes. Choose Yes on the form and tell us what you would like to share. Slots are limited and the organisers will confirm. How do I know my registration went through? A thank-you message appears on the page as soon as you register. The team will then contact you with the dates and delegate rates. Who do I ask if I have a question? WhatsApp the church office on +260 975 065 391 or email ccfczambia@gmail.com. Come home this December. Koinonia is where the family remembers it is one body. Whether you belong to a CCFC church or you are curious, there is a seat for you at Koi 26'.
